Row 4: Operational Execution Audit & Analyst Questions (Analyst Q&A Highlights)
WINS / DRAGS & ANALYST Q&A
What Management Did Right (Operational Wins)
  • Data Center Revenue Doubled (+96.9% YoY): Data Center expanded to $8,546M, establishing AMD as the primary dual-source provider for accelerated compute clusters.
  • Helios Rackscale Architecture Multi-Cloud Adoption: Secured volume production deployments across Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Oracle Cloud.
  • Colossal Q4 Guidance Raise to $17.0B: Management guided Q4 revenue to approximately $17.0B ± 3% (up +66% YoY), crushing Street consensus ($13.5B) by +$3.5B.
  • Server CPU Turin Market Share Expansion: 5th Gen EPYC server CPUs sustained rapid enterprise share gains against Intel Xeon.
What Went Wrong & Execution Headwinds
  • Gaming Segment Protracted Weakness (-40.4% YoY): Semi-custom console SoC revenues fell to $773M as PS5 and Xbox Series cycles enter late-stage deceleration.
  • Temporary Negative True FCF (-$598M): Working capital drag from pre-ramp inventory build combined with $1,152M SBC created quarterly cash compression.
  • Client Desktop Seasonality: Client revenue was down -3.7% QoQ to $2,949M, as consumer desktop channel demand normalized ahead of enterprise AI PC refreshes.
  • Advanced Packaging & CoWoS Execution Hurdles: Scaling Q4 to $17.0B requires flaw-free TSMC advanced packaging and high-bandwidth memory delivery.
Institutional Conference Call Analyst Questions & Executive Answers (Analyst Q&A)
Toshiya Hari (Goldman Sachs) Helios Rackscale Architecture Deployment & MI450 Hyperscaler Velocity

Question: Lisa, your Q4 guide of $17 billion represents an extraordinary $3.6B sequential jump. Can you detail how much of that acceleration is driven by Helios rackscale deployments, and what is the pipeline visibility across OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and Microsoft?

Executive Answer: Dr. Lisa Su (CEO) emphasized that Helios is transitioning from pilot validations into volume production across every Tier 1 hyperscaler: 'We have Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Oracle Cloud all running frontier workloads on Helios rackscale today. The transition to rack-level architectures with MI450 and 6th Gen EPYC provides customers 4x higher performance density. Our CoWoS packaging allocations and supply chain are secured to meet this demand.'

Vivek Arya (Bank of America) Operating Leverage, CapEx Escalation & Long-Term Gross Margin Target

Question: Jean, operating income grew 123% GAAP and operating margin reached 29% non-GAAP. As Helios scales in Q4 and into 2027, how should we think about gross margin progression and CapEx needs given the negative true free cash flow this quarter?

Executive Answer: Jean Hu (CFO) explained that the negative true FCF reflects working capital timing: 'Operating cash flow was impacted by inventory builds for the massive Q4 shipment surge. CapEx remained disciplined at $648M. As top-line volume ramps to $17B in Q4, operating margin will expand further, and cash conversion will normalize with significant positive cash flow in Q4 and FY27.'

Stacy Rasgon (Bernstein) Server CPU Turin / Venice Share vs Intel & Client NPU Momentum

Question: Lisa, server CPU revenue grew nicely alongside GPUs, while Client was down slightly QoQ. Are you seeing enterprise server refresh cycles pick up with Turin, and when does the PC client market see a broader enterprise refresh?

Executive Answer: Dr. Lisa Su noted that EPYC enterprise adoption is at record levels: 'Turin is taking share across general-purpose cloud instances and enterprise infrastructure. For Client, Ryzen mobile grew 7% YoY, and while desktop was seasonally soft, we expect enterprise AI PC adoption to accelerate in early 2027 as Copilot+ capabilities expand.'
